    Profile

    Nina is a young long-tail rabbit therian. She fights bravely in battle, despite her heightened hearing causing her to often overreact to loud noises. She likes to make stuffed toys that are soft to the touch and lovingly detailed out of her own molted fur.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 134cm
    Weight: 33kg
    Birthday: Jan 4
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Being hugged, apples
    Hobbies: Making plushies
    Illust: やもり
    CV: 大関英里
